learning: 先观察主体各部分怎样连接，再挑几处有特点的细节。
prompt: Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. One deep-sea exploration submersible in three-quarter view with a big spherical front window, two side lamps, small grabber arm and compact rear propeller. Simplification correction: use a clean PURE WHITE background, absolutely no gray shading or reflective patches. Hide all cockpit interior: the big front glass is one empty oval. Omit bolts, seams, wires and instrument panels. Draw grabber as only two smoothly joined segments and a simple two-prong end; rear propeller only three broad blades. About eight large interior marks total, roomy 12 percent margin.
